items.title: the variant-constructor type arguments the native emitter derives INSIDE generic instances are wrong: `map`'s `Some(f(x))` records `Some::<(Str, i32)>` (the receiver's `T`, not `U`); `and_then`'s `Err` records the wrong `T`
items.body: Latent only because Rust's inference ignores the bare path today (native-45's F55 first attempt — a turbofish on every constructor — broke six pins and was reverted). Rec: record per-instance variant arguments, or keep them out of anything emitted. Related: F65 (inferred returns are not per-instance either). Sizing M.

items.title: calling a LOCAL closure binding and then reading a member of the result fails rustc: `let make = \|n: i32\| Row {..}; print(make(1).name)` → E0282; `print(i"{f()}")` with `f = \|\| row.name` → E0277 (str unsized)
items.body: Cause: the closure literal is cast `as Rc<dyn Fn(..) -> _>` and a cast's `_` resolves too late. Present at the Order 45 base. Rec: write the closure's return type in the cast when it is grounded, non-async and not a view. Sizing S.

items.title: `print` of a long `List` diverges between backends: node's `util.inspect` wraps arrays past ~72 columns or 6 elements into rows; native prints one line (a 22-element `List<str>`)
items.body: Rec: define `print` of a list as single-line on both backends (N136's spirit), or implement node's grouping in the native `js_of`. An owner question if the JS output should change. Sizing S.

items.title: the JS `vilan run` prints its asset report (`Bundled  …`) on STDOUT ahead of the program's output; native prints nothing (`estate.vl` diverges for it)
items.body: Rec: build chatter goes to stderr. Sizing XS.
